key_result: A correlation spine (trace context, A2A and MCP metadata, business keys, probabilistic matching) assigns each usage record to a transaction with a recorded confidence.
takeaway: Proposes joining billing data in the FOCUS format to invocation-level telemetry so that AI cost can be assigned to individual business transactions.
title: The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record
why_it_matters: Provider billing arrives aggregated by SKU and period, so it cannot answer what one order or case cost in AI.
